panels.description: Number of sensors with data in the last 60 seconds

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) as active_sensors
FROM sensor s
JOIN sensor_measurement sm ON s.id = sm.sensor_id
WHERE sm.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '60 seconds'

panels.description: Time since last measurement for each sensor. Red indicates sensor may be offline.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    s.serial_number,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(sm.time)))::numeric as seconds_since_last_data
FROM sensor s
LEFT JOIN sensor_measurement sm ON s.id = sm.sensor_id
GROUP BY s.serial_number
ORDER BY seconds_since_last_data DESC

panels.title: Sensor Data Lag

panels.description: Status of all sensors with last measurement time and data count

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    s.serial_number,
    MAX(sm.time) as last_measurement,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(sm.time)))::numeric as data_lag_seconds,
    COUNT(*) as measurements_1h
FROM sensor s
LEFT JOIN sensor_measurement sm ON s.id = sm.sensor_id AND sm.time > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY s.serial_number
ORDER BY last_measurement DESC NULLS LAST

panels.description: Total size and decomposition of total size in terms of table itself, indexes and TOAST

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    created,
    table_bytes as table_size,
    index_bytes as index_size,
    toast_bytes as toast_size,
    total_size
FROM
    hypertables_size_history.detailed
WHERE hypertable_name = 'sensor_measurement'

panels.title: 'sensor_measurement' Table Size

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        created,
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM created - LAG(created) OVER w) AS delta_s,
        table_bytes - LAG(table_bytes) OVER w AS delta_table_bytes,
        index_bytes - LAG(index_bytes) OVER w AS delta_index_bytes,
        toast_bytes - LAG(toast_bytes) OVER w AS delta_toast_bytes,
        total_size  - LAG(total_size)  OVER w AS delta_total_bytes
    FROM hypertables_size_history.detailed
    WHERE hypertable_name = 'sensor_measurement' AND created > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY hypertable_name ORDER BY created)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    delta_table_bytes / NULLIF(delta_s,0)  AS table_bps,
    delta_index_bytes / NULLIF(delta_s,0)  AS index_bps,
    delta_toast_bytes / NULLIF(delta_s,0)  AS toast_bps,
    delta_total_bytes / NULLIF(delta_s,0)  AS total_bps
FROM deltas
WHERE delta_s IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created

links.title: best practices for time partitioning based on write rates

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        created,
        EXTRACT(epoch FROM created - LAG(created) OVER w) AS delta_s,
        total_size  - LAG(total_size)  OVER w AS delta_total_bytes
    FROM hypertables_size_history.detailed
    WHERE hypertable_name = 'sensor_measurement' AND created > NOW() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
    WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY hypertable_name ORDER BY created)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    ((delta_total_bytes / NULLIF(delta_s,0)) * 60 * 60 * 24) / power(1024, 3)   AS total_bps
FROM deltas
WHERE delta_s IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY created

panels.description: Disk and buffer writes over time

links.title: pg_stat_statements - track statistics of SQL planning and execution

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        created,
        extract('epoch' from created - lag(d.created) OVER (w)) AS delta_seconds,
        d.exec_writes - lag(d.exec_writes) OVER (w) AS delta_exec_writes,
        d.shared_blks_written - lag(d.shared_blks_written) OVER (w) AS delta_shared_blks_written,
        d.local_blks_written - lag(d.local_blks_written) OVER (w) AS delta_local_blks_written,
        d.temp_blks_written - lag(d.temp_blks_written) OVER (w) AS delta_temp_blks_written,
        d.wal_bytes - lag(d.wal_bytes) OVER (w) AS delta_wal_bytes,
        stats_reset
    FROM
        statements_history.snapshots AS d
    WHERE
        created > now() - INTERVAL '2 hours'
    WINDOW
        w AS (PARTITION BY stats_reset ORDER BY created ASC)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    delta_exec_writes / 1024.0 / 1024 / delta_seconds AS writes_MBps,
    (delta_shared_blks_written * 8.0) / 1024 / delta_seconds AS shared_buffer_MBps,
    (delta_local_blks_written * 8.0) / 1024 / delta_seconds AS local_buffer_MBps,
    (delta_temp_blks_written * 8.0) / 1024 / delta_seconds AS temp_buffer_MBps,
    delta_wal_bytes / 1024 / 1024 / delta_seconds AS wal_generated_MBps
FROM
    deltas
ORDER BY
    created ASC

panels.description: Cache Hit Ratio measures the percentage of database reads served from memory (cache) versus disk. Values above 99% are ideal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
    created as time,
    cache_hit_ratio
FROM statements_history.database_stats
WHERE datname = 'iot'
ORDER BY created DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Cache Hit Ratio

targets.rawSql:
WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        st.created,
        st.queryid,
        st.rolname,
        st.datname,
        s.stats_reset,
        q.query,
        st.calls - lag(st.calls) OVER (query_w) AS delta_calls,
        st.total_exec_time - lag(st.total_exec_time) OVER (query_w) AS delta_total_exec_time,
        extract('epoch' from st.created - lag(st.created) OVER (query_w)) AS delta_seconds
    FROM
        statements_history.statements AS st
    JOIN
        statements_history.queries AS q USING (queryid, datname, rolname)
    JOIN
        statements_history.snapshots AS s USING (created)
    WHERE
        st.created > now() - interval '15 minutes'
        AND st.created < now() + interval '15 minutes'
        AND q.query ILIKE 'insert into sensor_measurement%'
    WINDOW
        query_w AS (PARTITION BY st.datname, st.rolname, st.queryid, s.stats_reset ORDER BY st.created)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    query,
    delta_total_exec_time / NULLIF(delta_calls, 0) / 1000 AS exec_time_per_query
FROM
    deltas
WHERE
    delta_calls > 0
ORDER BY
    created ASC

WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        st.created,
        st.queryid,
        st.rolname,
        st.datname,
        s.stats_reset,
        q.query,
        st.calls - lag(st.calls) OVER (query_w) AS delta_calls,
        st.rows - lag(st.rows) OVER (query_w) AS delta_rows
    FROM
        statements_history.statements AS st
    JOIN
        statements_history.queries AS q USING (queryid, datname, rolname)
    JOIN
        statements_history.snapshots AS s USING (created)
    WHERE
        st.created > now() - interval '15 minutes'
        AND st.created < now() + interval '15 minutes'
        AND q.query ILIKE 'insert into sensor_measurement%'
    WINDOW
        query_w AS (PARTITION BY st.datname, st.rolname, st.queryid, s.stats_reset ORDER BY st.created)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    query,
    delta_rows / NULLIF(delta_calls, 0) AS rows_per_query
FROM
    deltas
WHERE
    delta_calls > 0
ORDER BY
    created ASC

WITH deltas AS (
    SELECT
        st.created,
        st.queryid,
        st.rolname,
        st.datname,
        s.stats_reset,
        q.query,
        st.calls - lag(st.calls) OVER (query_w) AS delta_calls,
        st.shared_blks_hit - lag(st.shared_blks_hit) OVER (query_w) AS delta_shared_blks_hit,
        st.shared_blks_read - lag(st.shared_blks_read) OVER (query_w) AS delta_shared_blks_read,
        extract('epoch' from st.created - lag(st.created) OVER (query_w)) AS delta_seconds
    FROM
        statements_history.statements AS st
    JOIN
        statements_history.queries AS q USING (queryid, datname, rolname)
    JOIN
        statements_history.snapshots AS s USING (created)
    WHERE
        st.created > now() - interval '15 minutes'
        AND st.created < now() + interval '15 minutes'
        AND q.query ILIKE 'insert into sensor_measurement%'
    WINDOW
        query_w AS (PARTITION BY st.datname, st.rolname, st.queryid, s.stats_reset ORDER BY st.created)
)
SELECT
    created AS "time",
    query,
    delta_shared_blks_hit / NULLIF(delta_calls, 0) * 8.0 / 1024 AS cache_hit_per_query,
    delta_shared_blks_read / NULLIF(delta_calls, 0) * 8.0 / 1024 AS cache_miss_per_query
FROM
    deltas
WHERE
    delta_calls > 0
ORDER BY
    created ASC
